title: Open Fracture: Key Red Flags and Infection Risk
subject: Surgical Triads
preview: An open fracture communicates with the external environment and carries risks of infection and soft-tissue injury.
quickRevision: An open fracture communicates with the external environment and carries risks of infection and soft-tissue injury.
Early antibiotics, tetanus assessment and timely debridement follow local trauma protocols.
Fracture appearance alone underestimates contamination and associated vessel or nerve damage.

sections.title: Recognize the pattern
points: An open fracture communicates with the external environment and carries risks of infection and soft-tissue injury.
Assess neurovascular status, control bleeding, cover with a clean dressing and urgently involve trauma or orthopedic teams.

sections.title: What this finding does—and does not—mean
points: Early antibiotics, tetanus assessment and timely debridement follow local trauma protocols.
Fracture appearance alone underestimates contamination and associated vessel or nerve damage.

sections.title: Exam trap — avoid this mistake
points: Never repeatedly probe the wound to establish whether bone is exposed.
